title: Restore separately and verify contents and metadata
goal: Recover into an empty destination while originals remain unchanged.
challenge: Restore both known files into a new separate directory. Compare exact member inventory, bytes, modes and mtime against originals; retain the original source and backup. Diagnose an incomplete but readable archive as insufficient.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-backup-5; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Guard a fresh, learner-owned workspace and check guest free space. Stop if any command fails.
steps.expected: Private practice directory; at least 65536 KiB available.

steps.command: guard() { test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-backup-5 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-backup-5 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && test -z "$(find . -type l -print -quit)"; }; guard
steps.explanation: Define and use a location/owner guard for every later change.
steps.expected: Exact physical path, not a link.

steps.command: guard && mkdir -m 0700 source && printf 'alpha\n' > source/note.txt && printf 'bravo\n' > 'source/space name.txt' && chmod 0640 source/note.txt && chmod 0600 'source/space name.txt' && touch -d '2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC' source/note.txt 'source/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Create two known regular files, including a name with a space.
steps.expected: alpha and bravo lines, modes640/600, fixed UTC timestamp.

steps.command: guard && test ! -e v1.tar && test ! -L v1.tar && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf v1.tar -C source -- note.txt 'space name.txt' && test "$(stat -c %s v1.tar)" -le 65536
guard && test ! -e restore && test ! -L restore && mkdir -m 0700 restore && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -xf v1.tar -C restore --no-same-owner --same-permissions
steps.explanation: Empty separate destination; --no-same-owner avoids privileged identity changes. --same-permissions restores archived file modes.

steps.command: guard && cmp -- source/note.txt restore/note.txt && cmp -- 'source/space name.txt' 'restore/space name.txt' && stat -c '%n %U:%G %a %Y %s' source/note.txt restore/note.txt 'source/space name.txt' 'restore/space name.txt'
steps.explanation: Compare bytes and relevant metadata, including space-containing names.
steps.expected: Both cmp status0; file modes640/600 and equalmtime.

steps.command: guard && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -cf incomplete.tar -C source -- note.txt && mkdir -m 0700 incomplete && timeout -k 1s 10s tar -xf incomplete.tar -C incomplete --no-same-owner --same-permissions; test -f 'incomplete/space name.txt'; printf 'required member status=%s\n' "$?"
steps.explanation: Valid syntax and successful extraction do not prove completeness.
steps.expected: Missing second member detected; good backup retained.

hints: A valid archive can be incomplete.
Compare names, bytes and metadata, not just extraction status.
review: Separate paths, equal data/metadata, missing-member detection and originals retained.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 103.3 and LPIC-2 v4.5 206.2 partial manual archives/recovery; 104.5 reinforcement where applicable. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
